title: Attention-complete panel to fifteen-minute return
claim: Causal social-attention features improve next-fifteen-minute return forecasts over the strongest market-only model across assets.
mechanism: Attention bursts precede rapid price incorporation of public information.

evidence.summary: The elastic-net winner passed 2/6 development folds; blind July loss improvement was 3.90e-9 with Holm-adjusted p=1.0.

nextAction: Do not refit on July; use a new signed-information mechanism and future confirmation period.
